text: {"assertions":["On 2026-08-06, a partial upload bug was fixed in storage/blob/uploader.rs.","The partial upload issue only manifested for traffic arriving through the corporate proxy.","The bug could be reproduced by uploading a 40 MB fixture over a throttled link.","The root cause was a listener that was registered but never removed during teardown.","The symptom was that the final upload part never received acknowledgment.","The fix involved removing the listener on teardown and adding a test assertion to prevent regression.","The fix was submitted as PR #1341 on the branch fix/partial-upload-1.","The backlog for this issue cleared 29 minutes after the deploy."]}
